tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the e-shop catalog by product name or EAN code. Public — no authentication needed. Every product carries the EAN, brand, pack size with its unit (kg for goods sold by weight, ks for goods sold by the piece) and the resulting price_per_unit, plus weight_kg. Prices are EXCLUDING VAT — price_vat

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full detail of one product: description, annotation, URL and everything the listing tools return. Public — no authentication needed. Every product carries the EAN, brand, pack size with its unit (kg for goods sold by weight, ks for goods sold by the piece) and the resulting price_per_unit, plus weig

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Full catalog category tree of the e-shop (ice-cream and pastry catalogs): names, absolute URLs and product counts per category. The best starting point for browsing the assortment structurally. Public — no authentication needed.

tools.name: list_category_products
tools.description: Paged list of products in one catalog category, by category id or URL slug (see list_categories). Public — no authentication needed. Every product carries the EAN, brand, pack size with its unit (kg for goods sold by weight, ks for goods sold by the piece) and the resulting price_per_unit, plus weig

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Current content of the customer's shopping cart with totals, transport cost and any system notes.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a quantity of a product to the cart (whole units, as in the web shop). Quantity is added to what is already in the cart. Products sold by whole cartons are rounded up to full cartons automatically.

tools.name: update_cart_item
tools.description: Set the absolute quantity of a product in the cart. Quantity 0 removes the product.

tools.name: clear_cart
tools.description: Remove all items from the shopping cart.

tools.name: create_delivery_address
tools.description: Create a delivery address (place of business) for this customer — required once before the first order, exactly as the web shop asks right after registration. Minimum: city, zip, house number, a contact surname and a phone for the carrier; street may be empty in villages without street names. Leave

tools.name: list_delivery_addresses
tools.description: Delivery addresses registered for this customer. Use the returned id as delivery_address_id in place_order when the customer has more than one. A brand-new customer has none yet — call create_delivery_address first.

tools.name: checkout_preview
tools.description: Preview the order before placing it: final items, totals including VAT and transport, delivery address and payment/delivery methods. Always call this before place_order.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place a REAL, BINDING order from the current cart on behalf of the customer. Requires confirm=true. The customer receives the standard order confirmation email.

tools.name: list_my_orders
tools.description: Recent orders of this customer with their status.

tools.name: get_my_order
tools.description: Detail of one order of this customer, including its items and status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "eshop" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product, list_categories, list_category_products · Private data: create_delivery_address · Public sink: place_order · Destructive: clear_cart.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product, list_categories, list_category_products · Private data: create_delivery_address · Public sink: place_order · Destructive: clear_cart

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
